mBuff.mDescription: This unit is being knocked back.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit is being knocked back.
K'Sante has stunned this unit. Make way!
K'Sante has rooted this unit. Get ready for him to go All Out.
K'Sante is knocking back this unit. Good luck.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.

When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for @spell.KSanteW:MinDurationTOOLTIP@-@spell.KSanteW:MaxDuration.1@s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by @spell.KSanteW:DamageReduction*100@%. Then, he rams forward, dealing @spell.KSanteW:BaseDamage@ + @spell.KSanteW:TotalMaxHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for @spell.KSanteW:MinKnockbackDuration@-@spell.KSanteW:MaxKnockbackDuration@ seconds (based on charge time).

All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional @spell.KSanteW:RDamageIncreaseMin*100@-@spell.KSanteW:RDamageIncreaseMax*100@% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to @spell.KSanteW:RDamageReduction*100@% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
K'Sante dashes and gains a shield. If targeting an ally, K'Sante dashes to the ally with increased range and both gain a shield.

When All Out, cooldown is reduced and speed is increased.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
K'Sante dashes, gaining @TotalShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. If dashing to an ally, the distance of the dash is significantly increased and the ally is also Shielded.

All Out: Cooldown is decreased by @CooldownModAO*100@% and dash speed is increased.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
K'Sante's Abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next Attack.

When All Out, K'Sante deals more damage with all Attacks and Abilities.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
K'Sante's damaging Abilities mark enemies hit. Attacking a marked enemy deals @FlatDamage@ plus @PercentHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage and consumes the mark.

All Out: K'Sante's Attacks, Abilities and Passive deal an additional @MaxHealthDamagePercent@ max Health physical damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_KSanteP_Tooltip}}

Damage against minions has a minimum cap of 15-100 (based on level).
Damage against monsters has a maximum cap of 20-105 (based on level).

mLocKeys.keySummary:
K'Sante strikes, damaging and slowing enemies in a short line.

On hit, grants a stack of Ntofo Strikes. At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.

When All Out, cooldown is reduced.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
K'Sante slams his weapon, dealing @BaseDamage@ physical damage and Slowing enemies by @SlowPercent*100@% for @SlowDuration@s. If he hits, he gains a stack of Ntofo Strikes for @RecastWindow@ seconds. At 2 stacks, he instead fires a shockwave that Stuns and Pulls enemies for @StunDuration@ second.

All Out: Cooldown is reduced by @RCooldownReduction.0*100@%.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Cooldown & cast time reduced by Bonus <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>: @f2@ / @DefenseCapforCooldown@.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path. Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
K'Sante shatters his ntofos to Knock Back an enemy champion, dealing @BaseDamage@ physical damage, then dashes behind them and goes All Out for @AllOutDuration@s. If the enemy would hit a wall, they are Knocked Back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for @TotalDamageSlamDown@ physical damage.

While All Out, K'Sante's Abilities are upgraded and he gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed, @ArmorPenPercent*100@% Bonus Armor Penetration, and @Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp, but loses @HealthLost*100@% max Health, @DefensesLost*100@% Bonus Armor, and @DefensesLost*100@% Bonus Magic Resistance.
